entries.title: II Kings 12:1
segments: And in the seventh year of Jehu, Joash began to reign. And he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. And his mother's name [was] Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

entries.title: II Kings 12:2
segments: And Joash did the right in the sight of the LORD all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

entries.title: II Kings 12:3
segments: But the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

entries.title: II Kings 12:4
segments: And Joash said to the priests, All the silver from things dedicated to God, which is brought into the house of the LORD, the silver from each man the silver of his valuation, all the silver that comes into any man's heart to bring to the house of the LORD,

entries.title: II Kings 12:5
segments: let the priests take [it] to themselves, each man from those he knows. And let them repair the breaks in the house, in all [places] where any break shall be found.

entries.title: II Kings 12:6
segments: And it happened in the twenty-third year of king Joash, the priests had not repaired the breaks of the house.

entries.title: II Kings 12:7
segments: Then king Joash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the priests, and said to them, Why are you not repairing the breaks of the house? And now take no silver from those you know, but deliver it for the breaks of the house.

entries.title: II Kings 12:8
segments: And the priests agreed to take no silver from the people, nor to repair the breaks of the house.

entries.title: II Kings 12:9
segments: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid. And he set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the house of the LORD. And the priests who kept the door put in it all the silver brought into the house of the LORD.

entries.title: II Kings 12:10
segments: And it happened when they saw that much silver [was] in the chest, the king's scribe and the high priest came up. And they bound and counted the silver that was found [in] the house of the LORD.

entries.title: II Kings 12:11
segments: And they gave the silver which was counted into the hands of those who did the work, those overseeing the house of the LORD. And they laid it out to the carpenters and builders who worked on the house of the LORD,

entries.title: II Kings 12:12
segments: and to masons and cutters of stone, and to buy timber and cut stone to repair the breaks of the house of the LORD, and for all that went forth for the house, to repair [it].

entries.title: II Kings 12:13
segments: Only, there were no bowls of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, or any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, made for the house of the LORD from the silver which [was] brought into the house of the LORD.

entries.title: II Kings 12:14
segments: For they gave it to the workmen, and repaired the house of the LORD with it.

entries.title: II Kings 12:15
segments: And they did not make an accounting with the men into whose hands they gave the silver to be given to the workmen. For they dealt faithfully.

entries.title: II Kings 12:16
segments: The trespass silver and sin silver was not brought into the house of the LORD. It was the priests'.

entries.title: II Kings 12:17
segments: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it. And Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Kings 12:18
segments: And Joash king of Judah took all the holy things which Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold found in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and in the king's house, and sent [it] to Hazael king of Syria. And he went away from Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Kings 12:19
segments: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah?

entries.title: II Kings 12:20
segments: And his servants arose and made a plot. And they killed Joash in the house of Millo, which goes down [to] Silla.

entries.title: II Kings 12:21
segments: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died. And they buried him with his fathers in the city of David. And Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
